title: compliancetf-manifest.json, schema 3.x typed subset
description: The subset of compliance manifest schema 3.x that ctfkit by compliance.tf reads, pinned to major 3 and written against 3.3 as served on 2026-09-20, plus the optional 3.4 supporting_clauses_by_framework. Fields the manifest schema defines but no analyzer reads are deliberately absent, and additionalProperties stays open at every level, so an additive minor bump needs no change here. A new major is refused by the loader, not by this schema: schema_version is pinned to ^3. so a schema 4 document fails validation, which is the same answer as the exit 2 the command gives.

schema_version.description: Major 3 only. ctfkit exits 2 on any other major.

controls_scope.description: package is the package-root manifest and the only one carrying manifest_set_hash and the build-level not-applicable and superseded sets. package-fallback is the stub emitted when attribution is unavailable.

scope_path.description: Package-root-relative POSIX path of the directory this manifest governs. The package root is the token ".".

framework_names.description: framework id to its human readable name.

controls.description: The controls this manifest lists for its own scope. An empty array means no control-attributed change here; it never means assessed and none apply.

status.description: enforced: this manifest's files_modified holds the evidence. delegated: every file the control changed is governed by another scope, named in applies_in.

applies_in.description: Every scope_path where this control has files. "." is the package root; an empty array means no files anywhere.

supporting_clauses_by_framework.description: 3.4, optional: per framework, the subset of clauses_by_framework the catalog curation marked as supporting (partial or indirect) evidence, which must not render as full enforcement. Absent means the producer does not classify, never that nothing is hedged; [] for a framework means classified and nothing hedged there.

controls_not_applicable.description: Package scope only. Tri-state: absent means the producer never classified, [] means it classified and found none.

controls_superseded.description: Package scope only. weaker control id to the stricter control id that replaced it. Tri-state: absent means the producer never reported, {} means it reported none.

operational_rules.description: Package scoped at every manifest; rules cannot be attributed per subtree.

ruleset.description: Set when a per-module-call ruleset selection added the rule. Absent means baseline posture, not unknown.

degraded.description: Tri-state: null means the producer never reported, [] means it reported nothing dropped, otherwise the reasons the org posture could not be applied in full.

does_not_prove.description: Machine-readable obligation tokens. A token this ctfkit release does not know is reported to the reader unchanged and never blocks.

package_manifest.description: Subtree manifests only: the relative path back to the package-scope manifest.

manifest_set_hash.description: Package scope only. SHA-256 over every manifest in the artifact. It detects staleness and partial replacement only; it is unsigned and is not an attestation.

packagePath.description: Package-root-relative, POSIX separated, no leading ./, no .., never absolute. The package root is ".".
